collection.description: An elder tells a wildly undignified story about a revered ancestor, shocking younger villagers.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (elder) tells a wildly undignified story about a revered ancestor, shocking younger villagers.

choices.label: Discuss Whether Heroes Can Be Silly
Turn It into a Storytelling Evening

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: An old drawing supports one funny detail but not the whole tale.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (elder) admits the story was embellished every time it was told.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: Relatives offer contradictory but affectionate versions.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (villager), a descendant, is embarrassed until they hear how kindly (elder) remembers the ancestor.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: Children decide that courage and foolish mistakes can coexist.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (villager) prefers solemn remembrance, and the group respects that preference.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: (elder) becomes the star of a night of harmless ancestral mishaps.

d2__fx.name: Outcome D2
d2__fx.text: (villager), a younger villager, tells an even funnier story about (elder), who laughs hardest of all.
